# Hide in caves high above the world, fix/worlds147. Compare the branch with main (the same version both times):
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=fix/worlds147 -f script=.github/checks/worlds147.txt
#   gh workflow run screenshots.yml --ref main -f version=1.21.11 -f mod_ref=main -f script=.github/checks/worlds147.txt
#
# Hide in caves on, Record card on, Lines in the sky, the Aurora night sky, a clear midnight. Spectator mode, so
# nothing falls: the Overworld's blocks end at y 319, and nothing is over you up there.
#   worlds-ground: on the ground, looking a little up: lyrics, top bar, Record card and aurora (both).
#   worlds-y1500:  teleported to y 1500: all four (both).
#   worlds-y3000:  teleported to y 3000: all four on the branch. main: no lyrics, no top bar, no Record card and no
#                  aurora, as if underground (the game's light lookup keeps 12 bits of the height, so at y 3000 it read
#                  the sky light at y -1096, under the bedrock).

cmd weather clear
cmd time set midnight
cmd gamerule doDaylightCycle false
cmd gamerule advance_time false
set recordCard true
set cardLyrics true
set layout LINES
set placement SKY
set sky AURORA
set hideInCaves true
cmd gamemode spectator @p
look 0 -20
sleep 6
seek 21
sleep 3
shot worlds-ground

cmd execute as @p at @s run tp @s ~ 1500 ~
sleep 5
seek 21
sleep 3
shot worlds-y1500

cmd execute as @p at @s run tp @s ~ 3000 ~
sleep 5
seek 21
sleep 3
shot worlds-y3000

set hideInCaves false
cmd gamemode creative @p
